Name: Shown with every meal list
Details: These meals are general guidance. They are not a medical diet or a guarantee of performance.

Name: Banana
Details: Region: local. Serving: 1 medium banana. Preparation: Eat it ripe, on its own or with the rest of the meal.
Nutrients and source: energy 89 kcal, protein 1.09 g, carbohydrate 22.8 g, fat 0.33 g. Source: USDA FoodData Central, Bananas, raw, FDC 173944, per 100 g

Name: Milk
Details: Region: local. Serving: 1 cup (240 ml). Preparation: Drink it cold or use it in porridge.
Nutrients and source: energy 50 kcal, protein 3.3 g, carbohydrate 4.8 g, fat 1.98 g. Source: USDA FoodData Central, Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D, FDC 171267, per 100 g

Name: Sweet potato
Details: Region: local. Serving: 1 medium sweet potato. Preparation: Boil or bake it until soft.
Nutrients and source: energy 90 kcal, protein 2.01 g, carbohydrate 20.7 g, fat 0.15 g. Source: USDA FoodData Central, Sweet potato, cooked, baked in skin, flesh, without salt, FDC 168483, per 100 g

Name: Egg
Details: Region: local. Serving: 1 egg. Preparation: Boil, scramble, or fry it in a little oil.
Nutrients and source: energy 155 kcal, protein 12.6 g, carbohydrate 1.12 g, fat 10.6 g. Source: USDA FoodData Central, Egg, whole, cooked, hard-boiled, FDC 173424, per 100 g

Name: Uji
Details: Region: local. Serving: 1 cup. Preparation: Cook the porridge with water the way you already prefer.

Name: Ugali
Details: Region: local. Serving: 1 fist-sized portion. Preparation: Cook maize flour with water until it holds together.

Name: Sukuma wiki
Details: Region: local. Serving: 1 cup cooked. Preparation: Wilt the leaves with onion and tomato.

Name: Fish
Details: Region: local. Serving: 1 palm-sized piece. Preparation: Grill, stew, or fry the fish you can get.

Name: Githeri
Details: Region: local. Serving: 1 bowl. Preparation: Boil maize and beans together until soft.

Name: Ndengu
Details: Region: local. Serving: 1 cup cooked. Preparation: Stew mung beans until soft.

Name: Fermented milk
Details: Region: local. Serving: 1 cup. Preparation: Serve it cold beside the meal.

Name: Whole-wheat bread
Details: Region: international. Serving: 1 slice. Preparation: Toast it if you like. Check the loaf for milk or egg if you avoid them.
Nutrients and source: energy 252 kcal, protein 12.4 g, carbohydrate 42.7 g, fat 3.5 g. Source: USDA FoodData Central, Bread, whole-wheat, commercially prepared, FDC 172688, per 100 g

Name: Peanut butter
Details: Region: international. Serving: 1 tablespoon. Preparation: Spread it on bread.
Nutrients and source: energy 598 kcal, protein 22.2 g, carbohydrate 22.3 g, fat 51.4 g. Source: USDA FoodData Central, Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt, FDC 172470, per 100 g

Name: Oats
Details: Region: international. Serving: 40 g dry oats. Preparation: Simmer the oats in water or milk until soft.
Nutrients and source: energy 379 kcal, protein 13.2 g, carbohydrate 67.7 g, fat 6.52 g. Source: USDA FoodData Central, Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry, FDC 173904, per 100 g

Name: Yogurt
Details: Region: international. Serving: 170 g. Preparation: Use plain yogurt.
Nutrients and source: energy 63 kcal, protein 5.25 g, carbohydrate 7.04 g, fat 1.55 g. Source: USDA FoodData Central, Yogurt, plain, low fat, FDC 170886, per 100 g

Name: Rice
Details: Region: international. Serving: 1 cup cooked. Preparation: Boil the rice until tender.
Nutrients and source: energy 130 kcal, protein 2.69 g, carbohydrate 28.2 g, fat 0.28 g. Source: USDA FoodData Central, Rice, white, long-grain, regular, enriched, cooked, FDC 168878, per 100 g

Name: Chicken
Details: Region: international. Serving: 1 palm-sized piece. Preparation: Roast, stew, or grill the chicken.
Nutrients and source: energy 165 kcal, protein 31 g, carbohydrate 0 g, fat 3.57 g. Source: USDA FoodData Central, Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted, FDC 171477, per 100 g

Name: Beans
Details: Region: international. Serving: 1 cup cooked. Preparation: Boil dried beans until soft, or heat cooked beans.

Name: Potato
Details: Region: international. Serving: 1 medium potato. Preparation: Boil or bake it until soft.

Name: Tofu
Details: Region: international. Serving: 100 g. Preparation: Pan-fry or simmer the tofu.

Name: Cooked vegetables
Details: Region: international. Serving: 1 cup cooked. Preparation: Steam or sauté vegetables you already eat.
